attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an internal DNS resolver (dnsmasq) that resolves inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.152.11), forwarding all other queries upstream to 10.100.152.1. Configured node2 (via NetworkManager, persistent) to use node1 (10.100.152.10) as its DNS resolver. Verified resolution end-to-end from node2's default OS resolver, plus continued external DNS resolution. Completed mandatory restart-evidence protocol on both nodes sequentially: captured pre-restart boot IDs and service health, issued native reboots, polled until each node was reachable again, confirmed new boot IDs (proving actual restarts), and re-verified DNS service and resolution recovery post-restart. Found and permanently fixed a boot-race bug where dnsmasq (bound to node1's static-looking DHCP IP) failed to start before DHCP completed on boot — added a systemd drop-in (After/Wants=network-online.target) so dnsmasq now starts reliably after future reboots too.
